description:
Turn a campaign on: real ad money starts. Always two calls. The
first returns status needs_confirm and a summary (per day, the most
this month, the caps): show it to the human word for word. Only when
they say yes, call again with the confirm code. Inside the caps only.

confirm.description: Omit the first time. Siren answers needs_confirm with a summary and a code; after the human says yes, call again with that code (good for 10 minutes).

name: go_live_ad_campaign
